result.topic_en: An archivist's slip (not by Ramanujan) describing an incomplete manuscript intended as the conclusion to Ramanujan's paper 'On certain trigonometrical sums', noting that the last two pages are scraps on the same subject.
result.transcription:
with Add. Ms. a. 94^{18 (20)}
Incomplete?
Intended as conclusion to "Certain Trigonometrical Sums" 21. p. 129.
[-Does not seem to do find $\sum_1^\infty \Lambda_s(n)x^n$ or $\sum_1^\infty \sigma_s(n)x^n$ as it sets out to do-]
Last 2 pages scraps on the same subject.

items.quote: [-Does not seem to do find $\sum_1^\infty \Lambda_s(n)x^n$ or $\sum_1^\infty \sigma_s(n)x^n$ as it sets out to do-]
items.english: (Struck out) It does not seem to find the sum over n from 1 to infinity of Λ_s(n)x^n or of σ_s(n)x^n, as it sets out to do.
